abilities.name: Vehement Aggression
abilities.text:
In the Fight phase, when this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**, you can use this ability. If you do, make a **[gloss:leadership-roll:leadership roll]** for this unit:
▪ This unit's melee attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]** of 1.
▪ __Or:__ If that roll succeeds: This unit's melee attacks:
▪ Can re-roll **hit rolls** of 1.
▪ Can re-roll **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]** of 1.

default.flavor: A Castellan leads each of a crusade’s fighting companies and acts as a conduit for their Marshal’s will. Charged with the physical and spiritual purity of active Chapter Keeps, they have honed a patient wisdom that they draw upon in battle, alongside their tactical precision and close-quarters ferocity.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Combi-weapon; 1 Master-crafted Power Weapon.
default.name: Castellan
options: This model's Combi-weapon can be replaced with 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol.
This model's Master-crafted Power Weapon can be replaced with 1 Chainsword.

abilities.name: Temple Relics
abilities.text: At the start of your Command phase, if this unit contains one or more CENOBYTE SERVITOR models, select up to one of the abilities in the Temple Relics section. Until the start of your next Command phase, this model has that ability.

abilities.name: Litanies of the Devout
abilities.text: This unit's melee attacks can re-roll **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

abilities.name: Faithful Cenobytes
abilities.text:
▪ If this unit’s Chaplain Grimaldus model is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, this unit’s remaining Cenobyte Servitor models are also **destroyed**.
▪ Each Cenobyte Servitor model in this unit takes up 0 **[gloss:transport-capacity:transport capacity]**.

options.name: Banner of the Emperor Victorious
options.text: This unit has +1 to **[gloss:advance-roll:advance rolls]** and **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

options.name: Water from the Stoup of Elucidation

default.flavor: High Chaplain Grimaldus is a beacon of Imperial faith. His fortitude is such that many of his brothers believe him invincible. His will is singular, his zeal coldly furious, and his martial skill attested by the trail of broken foes laid at his heels. His Cenobyte Servitors lurch to war at his side, bearing with them holy relics of the faith.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

default.loadout:
**The Chaplain Grimaldus is equipped with:** 1 Artificier Crozius; 1 Plasma Pistol.
**Every Cenobyte Servitor is equipped with:** 1 Servitor Combat Weapon.
default.name: Chaplain Grimaldus

abilities.name: Vengeful Exhortation
abilities.text:
In the Fight phase, you can use this ability. If you do, when a model in this unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]**, if this unit has not been **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]** this phase, roll one D6:
▪ On a 4+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this model is removed from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Martial Honour (Once per battle, per unit)
abilities.text: If this unit's melee attacks **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** an enemy unit this phase, you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the battle, this model has +5 **[gloss:objective-control:OC]**.

default.flavor: Carrying their crusade’s icons and sacred standards, these veteran wardens are honoured warriors of exceptional resolve and determination. They raise high the tapestries depicting the crusade’s victories and the God-Emperor’s glory, exhorting their fellow Black Templars to greater heights of weaponised hate.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Bolt Pistol; 1 Master-crafted Power Weapon.
default.name: Crusade Ancient

abilities.name: Righteous Zeal
abilities.text: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** by those attacks, this unit can make a **[gloss:surge-move:surge move]** of up to D6+1".

default.flavor: Crusader Squads storm into battle with bolt rifles blazing and chainswords howling. Initiates aim jets of fire from their pyreblasters or swing crackling power fists into their foes, while hard-eyed Neophytes fight furiously to prove their martial worth under the stem gaze of their mentors.
default.loadout:
**The Sword Brother is equipped with:** 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol; 1 Master-crafted Power Weapon.
**Every Neophyte is equipped with:** 1 Bolt Pistol; 1 Neophyte Chainsword.
**Every Initiate is equipped with:** 1 Bolt Pistol; 1 Bolt Rifle; 1 Knives and Fists.
default.name: Crusader Squad
options: Any number of Initiate models can each have their Bolt Rifle replaced with 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol and 1 Initiate Chainsword.
Any number of Neophyte models can each have their Bolt Pistol and Neophyte Chainsword replaced with 1 Shotgun and 1 Combat Knife.
The Sword Brother can have their Heavy Bolt Pistol replaced with 1 Hand Flamer.
For every 10 models in this unit, up to 2 Initiate models can each have their Bolt Rifle replaced with one of the following: 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol and 1 Power Fist, 1 Pyreblaster

abilities.name: Chosen of the Emperor
abilities.text: You cannot include more than one EMPEROR'S CHAMPION unit in your army.

abilities.name: Armour of Faith
abilities.text: Attacks allocated to this model have ‑1 **[gloss:damage-roll:D]**.

abilities.name: Sigismund's Heir
abilities.text: This unit has +1 to **[gloss:charge-roll:charge rolls]**.

default.flavor: A humble warrior touched by greatness, the Emperor’s Champion strides to battle wreathed in divine light. The furious blows of the enemy ring from his nigh-impenetrable Armour of Faith. In return, the Emperor’s Champion seeks out the leaders of the foe and, with sweeping blows from his Black Sword, strikes them down.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Black Sword; 1 Bolt Pistol.
default.name: Emperor's Champion

abilities.name: Remorseless Persecution
abilities.text: In your Movement phase, when this unit is selected to make an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, that **advance move** does not prevent this unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

abilities.name: Condemnatory Annihilation
abilities.text: After this unit has fought, if this unit **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** an enemy model this phase, each enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with this unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle-shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.

default.flavor: Execrators are living exemplars of their battle-brothers’ oaths, ferocious warrior priests who lead the Black Templars in lethal rampages. They teach that waris the most worthy chapel for warriors, every bludgeoning blow of their crozius arcanum punctuated with zealous invective and roared sermons.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Absolvor Bolt Pistol; 1 Crozius Arcanum.
default.name: Execrator
options: This model's Absolvor Bolt Pistol can be replaced with 1 Hand Flamer.
If this model is equipped with 1 Absolvor Bolt Pistol, it can be equipped with 1 Master-crafted Power Weapon (this model's 1 Absolvor Bolt Pistol cannot be replaced).

abilities.name: Aquilon Optics
abilities.text:
This unit’s ranged attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can:
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:hit-roll:hit roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:wound-roll:wound roll]**.
▪ Re-roll __one__ **[gloss:damage-roll:damage roll]**.

default.flavor: With pinpoint accuracy, Gladiator Lancer crews use this battle tank’s laser destroyer to spear through the heaviest enemy armour and punch smouldering holes in the flesh of xenos monstrosities. Such is the range of its heavy cannon that it can eliminate threats to the Black Templars before their battle-brothers encounter them, storming past their wrecks to seek the next affront to the Emperor.
default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Armoured Hull; 1 Defensive Array; 1 Laser Destroyer.
default.name: Gladiator Lancer
options: This model can be equipped with 1 Multi-melta

abilities.name: Reaping Tally
abilities.text: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.

default.flavor: When the cannons of the Gladiator Reaper spin to full pitch, the whining drone is likened to the sharpening of the Emperor’s just blade and a sensation which only truly discomforts the blasphemous. Within seconds, thousands of spent casings pour over the battle tank’s armoured hide as enemies are erased from existence by the storm of fire.
default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Armoured Hull; 1 Defensive Array; 1 Twin Heavy Onslaught Gatling Cannon.
default.name: Gladiator Reaper
options: This model can be equipped with 1 Multi-melta

abilities.name: Priority Target Acquisition
abilities.text: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 12" of this unit have +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.

default.flavor: The Valiant lays down blistering volleys of holy fire as it escorts transports or supports infantry in ferocious fighting, executing singular threats and vaporising squads of heavily armoured heretics with equal ease. Its twin las-talons spit vindicated death at the foe, making short work of enemy armour, while its hissing multi-meltas turn fortified positions into bubbling slag.
default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Armoured Hull; 1 Defensive Array; 2 Multi-melta; 1 Twin Las-talon.
default.name: Gladiator Valiant
options: This model can be equipped with 1 Multi-melta

abilities.name: High Marshal
abilities.text:
At the start of the Fight phase, select up to one enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with this unit and roll one D6:
▪ On a 2-3, that enemy unit suffers D3 **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
▪ On a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 3 **mortal wounds**.
▪ On a 6+, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 **mortal wounds**.

abilities.name: Crusade of Wrath
abilities.text:
This unit's melee attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
▪ +1 **[gloss:strength:S]**.

default.flavor: Helbrecht is the living embodiment of his Chapter’s warrior spirit. Wielding the Sword of the High Marshals, he storms into the fray, bellowing oaths of vengeance as he leads the unstoppable charge. His battle-brothers follow him without question, for they believe where High Marshal Helbrecht treads, so too walks the Emperor himself.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Ferocity; 1 Sword of the High Marshals.

melee.name: Sword of the High Marshals – strike
Sword of the High Marshals – sweep

default.name: High Marshal Helbrecht

abilities.name: Rapid Disembarkation
abilities.text: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**, units embarked within this unit can make a **[gloss:shock-disembark-move:shock disembark move]** (pg 157).

default.flavor: Equipped with vectored thrusters that make it faster than any other gravitic tank in the Space Marines’ armouries, the Impulsor is a highly adaptable transport used by all Primaris Space Marines for rapid insertion and flanking manoeuvres. It is particularly favoured by Vanguard forces.
default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Armoured Hull; 1 Storm Bolters.
default.name: Impulsor
options: This model's Storm bolters can be replaced with 1 Fragstorm grenade launchers.
This model can be equipped with one of the following: 1 Ironhail heavy stubber, 1 Multi-melta
This model can be equipped with one of the following: 1 Bellicatus missile array, 1 Orbital Comms Array, 1 Shield Dome
default.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 7 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. It cannot transport Terminator or Jump Pack models. Each Gravis model takes up the space of 2 models.

abilities.name: Inspirational Exemplar
abilities.text: This unit's melee attacks have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

abilities.name: Pious Fervour
abilities.text: When this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**, you can use this ability. If you do, this model's melee attacks have +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]** for each enemy unit within 6" of this model (to a maximum of +3 **A**).

default.flavor: Each Black Templars crusade is led by a Marshal. Similar in rank to the Captains of other Chapters, Marshals are fearsome combatants and paragons of strategic acumen. Ensuring a crusade’s purity and success is a sacred duty, and Marshals fight with sanctified relic weapons while acting as beacons of pious fervour for their warriors.

leader.text: This model can be attached to the following units:

default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Master-crafted Power Weapon; 1 Plasma Pistol.
default.name: Marshal
options: This model's Plasma Pistol can be replaced with 1 Combi-weapon.

abilities.name: Combat Embarkation
abilities.text: In your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit has selected **[gloss:charge-target:charge targets]**, you can select one friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that was one of those **charge targets** and is eligible to embark within this TRANSPORT. If every model in that unit is within 3" of this TRANSPORT, that unit can embark within this TRANSPORT. That enemy unit can then select new **charge targets** for that **[gloss:charge-move:charge move]**.

default.flavor: Clad in advanced armour plating and armed for any battlefield situation, the Repulsor not only transports its passengers safely, it also provides superb fire support. Dangerous terrain is little impediment to it, its ventral plates channelling gravitic energies that crush obstacles beneath the vehicle’s mass.
default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Armoured Hull; 1 Defensive Array; 1 Heavy Onslaught Gatling Cannon; 1 Hunter-slayer Missile; 1 Twin Heavy Bolter.
default.name: Repulsor
options: This model's Twin heavy bolter can be replaced with 1 Twin lascannon.
This model can be equipped with 1 Multi-melta
This model's Heavy onslaught gatling cannon can be replaced with 1 Las-talon.
default.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 14 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. Each Terminator, Gravis, Jump Pack, Wulfen model takes up the space of 2 models.

abilities.text: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit not **[gloss:half-strength:below half-strength]** have +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.

default.flavor: Based on the Repulsor chassis, the Repulsor Executioner sacrifices some transport capacity to accommodate powerful turret weaponry. Even the largest battle tanks can be crippled by the beam of a heavy laser destroyer, while the incinerating blasts of a macro plasma incinerator can obliterate infantry formations.
default.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** 1 Armoured Hull; 1 Defensive Array; 1 Heavy Laser Destroyer; 1 Heavy Onslaught Gatling Cannon; 1 Twin Heavy Bolter.
default.name: Repulsor Executioner
options: All models in this unit can each have their Heavy laser destroyer replaced with 1 Macro plasma incinerator.

abilities.text: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with this unit ends a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**, if this unit is **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** it can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to 6".

default.flavor: Every Sword Brother has earned their place amongst the Marshal’s household through acts of unswerving faith and spectacular violence. On the battlefield, they are reaping whirlwinds, unstoppable, uncompromising, and armed with a lethal assortment of weapons, and they turn upon the enemy in the Emperor’s name.
default.loadout: **Every model is equipped with:** 1 Chainsword; 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol.
default.name: Sword Brethren Squad
options: For every 4 models in this unit, up to 2 models can each have their Heavy Bolt Pistol replaced with 1 Hand Flamer.
Any number of models can each have their Chainsword replaced with 1 Master-crafted Power Weapon.
For every 4 models in this unit, 1 model can have their Chainsword replaced with 1 Thunder Hammer.
For every 4 models in this unit, 1 model can have their Heavy Bolt Pistol replaced with 1 Plasma Pistol.
For every 4 models in this unit, 1 model can have their Heavy Bolt Pistol and Chainsword replaced with 1 Twin Lightning Claws.
